question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
delta_reason: Expired at EOD Sep 6. Pezeshkian's ~Sep 1 statement — Tehran 'prepared to reciprocate' if the US returns to June ceasefire conditions — was a conditioned offer. Per F2's pre-declared ambiguity_rule, conditional or preconditioned offers resolve AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition. Trump's Sep 2 statement ('waved off the idea of a deal entirely, warning Iran would be hit far harder if it retaliates again') is an explicit non-acceptance. No unconditional Iranian public commitment to talks was detected before EOD Sep 6. Sep 5-6 bilateral kinetic exchange (IRGC ballistic missiles at US carrier group; CENTCOM strikes on Iranian oil carriers; IRGC tanker strikes in Hormuz) further foreclosed any within-window diplomatic reversal.
resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, Supreme National Security Council, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States.
resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
resolution_note: Pezeshkian ~Sep 1 (Time) stated Tehran 'prepared to reciprocate' if US returns to June conditions — conditional per ambiguity_rule. Trump Sep 2 (IranWarLive) waved off deal explicitly. Sep 5: IRGC ballistic missiles at US carrier group; CENTCOM struck three Iranian oil carriers. Sep 6: IRGC targeted three oil tankers and three US-affiliated ships. No unconditional Iranian commitment to talks observed before EOD Sep 6.
graveyard_reason: Resolved NO at horizon. Conditional offer applies ambiguity_rule (RESOLVE-AS-NO); US rejected condition; no unconditional statement detected.
